note: Gazetteer for pipeline/tag_x.py. 'aliases' match on word boundaries, case-insensitive and accent-insensitive. 'ambiguous_aliases' (place names that are also surnames, other countries' provinces or common words) only count when the post or the account default names the same country. Group 'case_sensitive' aliases must match exact case. Accounts: tier, source_type, country and default_region applied when the text names no place.

regions.name: Aisén del General Carlos Ibáñez del Campo
aliases: Aisén del General Carlos Ibáñez del Campo
